<reason>Side A won a competitive debate by making the live choice easier: a continental spine is extra lookup power, not the missing clinic, and purpose limits written at AU level do not create a hearing body in the worst-governed states the system must include. Side B kept mobility, leakage, and already-unaccountable surveillance in play, but repeatedly treated national papers as if they were CON's whole alternative and never neutralized presented-credential recognition versus a standing query path.</reason>
